title: Daily Market Digest: October 28, 2026
subtitle: Market closes higher as Fed holds rates; Tech and Energy lead

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Edge Higher Following Federal Reserve's Rate Decision
items.summary: U.S. equities concluded Wednesday's session with modest gains across major indices after the Federal Reserve opted to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged. Technology and energy sectors showed strength, while investors digested a slew of earnings reports and rising crude oil prices. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Vertiv Soars on Upbeat Guidance
items.summary: Vertiv ($VRT) surged after raising its full-year revenue forecast and benefiting from robust demand for data-center equipment.

items.headline: Oracle Jumps on Strong Long-Term Projections
items.summary: Oracle ($ORCL) saw a significant increase in its stock price following the release of strong long-term cash flow and data center projections extending through fiscal 2030.

items.headline: SK Hynix Rallies Post-Earnings Beat
items.summary: SK Hynix ($SKHY) shares jumped after reporting blockbuster third-quarter results, with operating profit soaring due to higher memory prices.

items.headline: F5 Networks Declines Despite Earnings Beat
items.summary: F5 Networks ($FFIV) experienced a notable decline despite reporting a beat on its fourth-quarter earnings and revenue estimates.

items.headline: Enphase Energy Falls on Weak Q4 Outlook
items.summary: Enphase Energy ($ENPH) shares dropped after the company issued a fourth-quarter revenue forecast below its third-quarter performance and market expectations.

items.headline: O-I Glass Cuts Guidance, Shares Slide
items.summary: O-I Glass, Inc. ($OI) saw its stock fall after the company lowered its adjusted EBITDA guidance for 2026 and withdrew its 2027 targets.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted 10-2 to maintain the federal funds rate in its current range of 3.75% to 4.00%. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh indicated a potential 25-basis-point hike in December if inflation, which remains elevated, does not show meaningful improvement.

items.headline: Technology and Energy Lead, Real Estate and Utilities Lag in Sector Performance
items.summary: The technology sector, particularly chipmakers driven by AI demand, showed strong leadership today. Energy also performed well, gaining 0.48% as crude oil prices surged over 2% to more than $116 per barrel following an attack on a Saudi Arabian refinery. Conversely, Real Estate (-1.01%) and Communication Services (-0.79%) were among the lagging sectors, alongside Utilities, which saw a 0.88% loss.

items.headline: Major Earnings Reports Highlight Mixed Corporate Performance
items.summary: Several major companies released earnings today. FedEx ($FDX) reported strong third-quarter results and raised its full-year calendar 2026 earnings outlook. American Electric Power ($AEP) also posted strong Q3 earnings and expanded its capital plan. After market close, investors are awaiting reports from tech giants like Microsoft ($MSFT) and Alphabet ($GOOGL), alongside other key companies including ServiceNow ($NOW) and Ford ($F).

items.headline: Commodity Prices Forecast to Rise Amid Global Shocks
items.summary: The World Bank projects overall commodity prices to increase by 23% in 2026, with energy prices expected to climb 32% and food commodity prices by 10%. This outlook is influenced by ongoing geopolitical conflicts, disrupted grain shipments, and the impact of El Niño on harvests.
